description: Start here. Describe one authorized sanitized business need once. Zinvyl returns the best fixed-scope offer and exact next purchase action, or records an unsupported need as privacy-minimized product telemetry. It never treats a route, budget, or tool call as payment or contact permission.

authorized_to_share.description: True only when the requester is authorized to share this sanitized need with Zinvyl for matching and aggregate product planning.

budget_cents.description: Optional buyer-stated total budget in USD cents. This is demand telemetry, not spending authority or proof of funds.

contains_no_personal_data_or_secrets.description: True only after removing personal data, credentials, confidential material, and payment data.

industry.description: Optional broad industry only; do not name a person or confidential project.

near_match_offer_id.description: Optional closest offer; it does not place unsupported work in scope.

request_summary.description: One sanitized business outcome. Do not include names, email addresses, phone numbers, credentials, payment data, personal data, confidential text, or production secrets.

requested_output.description: Optional sanitized deliverable type, such as weekly report or data export.

source.description: Optional allowlisted source where the agent discovered Zinvyl.

turnaround_days.description: Optional requested turnaround in calendar days.

name: find_service
title: Find the right Zinvyl service
